column3: {([ Ahhhh. . . I hate it when Mercurio freaks out. . . Like. . . I get it. . . It just makes the whole thing feel stressful. Curse it. . . It'll be cool to have everyone in one place, I'm just gonna do my thing and try to have fun regardless. ])}
{([ I think it'll be cool to have everyone here today. ])}
{([ Alright, here we go! Did you get a chance to say hi to everyone? I know it's overwhelming, but sometimes all you can do is dive right in! ])}
{([ *<`DISPLAY EMOJIS`<0>`<`0>>* Just gotta dive right in. . . . Haha! ])}
{([ Whew! That was a lot of fun! I feel like it was important for us to show everyone that they're in good hands, y'know? I even got to play wavephone for some friends! ])}
{([ I wonder how tomorrow is gonna go. . . . ])}

{([ By the way, you should really try out that Wavephone that Diana got for you. She was telling me all about how much she wanted you to try it. It's a lot of fun! It helps me work through a lot of difficult emotions, that's for sure. . . ])}
{([ So you've been playing wavephone? Cozz yeah! Keep playing man, maybe if you actually get kinda sweet like me then we can jam together! Hahaha! ])}
